reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 affirmatively preserves Customer's right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and records that no no-hire commitment was made, which meets the preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct treatment for a compliant finding and for a clause that benefits our party.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because there is no non-solicit covenant to measure; the regexes simply find no numeric term or carve-out sentence in an absence-of-restriction clause.
The rationale properly avoids double-flagging the § 12.4 non-compete, which is a distinct restrictive covenant handled under another rule.
